In this edition of ‘Everyday Explained,’ HT lifestyle spoke to Dr Madhura M, consultant retina, cataract and refractive surgeon at Vasan Eye Care, Jayanagar, to understand the reason behind this.

stories.title: How do autistic people parse information? A video game can help say
stories.summary: Scientists use special tests to understand how autistic people see, hear, and process information. But many of these tests require participants to understand complex spoken rules, speak their answers out loud or fill out long written questionnaires. For instance, a standard perception study might ask a participant to watch a screen and say out loud which direction a cluster of dots is moving.

stories.title: Does our ethnicity change how we experience dying?
stories.summary: BBC News Published 3 minutes ago We're all going to die - and whether we think about it consciously or not, we generally hope that it will be as smooth as possible for ourselves and our loved ones. But a study published earlier this year by King's College London and the University of Sheffield suggests that your ethnicity could play a role in how likely this is to be the case.

stories.title: Everyday explained: Why new shoes cause painful blisters even when they fit you perfectly
stories.summary: Buying a new pair of shoes is always exciting, but the experience can quickly turn uncomfortable when they start causing painful blisters. In this edition of HT Lifestyle’s ‘Everyday Explained’ series, we spoke to Avi Kumar, founder and CEO of footwear brand House of Avi and Jaya Tahilramani, director of London Rag, to understand what makes new footwear uncomfortable and why our feet need time to adjust.

stories.title: GTA 6 Launches Tonight: India Release Time, Price, Platforms, Preload Details, and Everything You Need to Know
stories.summary: After more than 13 years since the release of Grand Theft Auto V, Rockstar Games is finally bringing players the next mainline entry in its hugely popular open-world series. Grand Theft Auto VI is set to arrive today (November 19), taking players back to Vice City in the fictional state of Leonida.

stories.title: Can AI Run a Factory? Siemens Launches Eigen Engineering Agent in India
stories.summary: Siemens has launched its Eigen Engineering Agent in India, a purpose-built AI tool designed to handle automation engineering tasks. The system can perform PLC coding, HMI visualisation and device configuration within real engineering environments. Siemens says the agent has already been successfully piloted with more than 16 customers across India.

stories.title: How to Check PUC Certificate Validity Online: New Rules, Renewal Periods Explained
stories.summary: The changes have been notified under the Central Motor Vehicles (Sixteenth Amendment) Rules, 2026, through an official Gazette notification issued on Thursday, November 19. One of the key changes is the extended validity offered to newer BS-VI compliant vehicles. Meanwhile, vehicles following older Bharat Stage emission standards will continue to have shorter certificate renewal cycles.

stories.title: Why did the U.S. lose its measles-free status? | In Focus Podcast
stories.summary: The big news in the health sector this week was that the United States lost its ‘measles free’ status, a status that it had held from the year 2000 onwards. S. this year alone. As per data put out by the Unicef, 96% of cases are in unvaccinated people or those with unknown vaccination status.

stories.title: Is Your Console Ready for Grand Theft Auto 6? 10 Things to Check Before Playing
stories.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 is now out on PS5 and Xbox Series S/X. Before you dive into the game, you need to make sure your console is ready for it. From ensuring you have the required storage space to updating the system software, here are 10 things you should do to keep your PS5 or Xbox Series S/X console ready for GTA 6.

stories.title: Multilingual SARAN platform launched to assist Sabarimala pilgrims
stories.summary: Thiruvananthapuram, A six-language digital platform offering travel information, details of facilities and local updates for Sabarimala pilgrims has been launched by the Keralam Local Self Government Department to make the annual pilgrimage safer and more convenient. The SARAN platform, developed by the department's IT wing, was officially launched by LSGD Minister K M Shaji.

stories.title: Raj Nidimoru’s sister visits temple, dargah and church to pray for Dev
stories.summary: Samantha Ruth Prabhu and filmmaker Raj Nidimoru welcomed their first child, a baby boy named Dev Nidimoru, on November 19. Raj Nidimoru's sister visits Temple, Dargah and church for DevSheetal shared pictures on Instagram from her visits to Haji Ali Dargah, Siddhivinayak Temple and St. Michael's Church. She was accompanied by their aunt, whom she affectionately called Neeru Pinni.

stories.title: Maharashtra: MSRTC deploys 1,000 additional buses for Kartiki Ekadashi
stories.summary: The Maharashtra State Road Transport Corporation (MSRTC) has kept around 1,000 additional buses ready to ferry devotees to Pandharpur for the Kartiki Ekadashi pilgrimage on November 21. With lakhs of Warkaris expected to visit the temple town to seek the blessings of Lord Vitthal, MSRTC focuses on assuring proper facilities to pilgrims.

stories.title: Sabarimala pilgrims can now take direct AC buses from Thiruvananthapuram, Kochi airports to Pamba
stories.summary: Thiruvananthapuram, Keralam Minister C P John on Friday announced enhanced travel facilities for Sabarimala pilgrims, with direct AC bus connectivity from two airports to Pamba and chartered services from their localities. John flagged off the Kerala State Road Transport Corporation's first AC bus service from Thiruvananthapuram International Airport to Pamba on Thursday night, according to a statement issued this morning.

stories.title: Sadhguru on inner peace: Why your mind could be behind your everyday frustration
stories.summary: Your mind can shape how you experience everyday life. A difficult conversation, an unexpected problem or a stressful day at work can leave you feeling angry, worried or frustrated. Sometimes, even when nothing goes wrong, your thoughts can make you feel unhappy. Spiritual leader Sadhguru has recently shared a thought about the connection between your mind and emotions.

stories.title: 5 states of the human mind explained through Yogic philosophy and Arjuna's journey in the Bhagavad Gita
stories.summary: When you look at Arjuna's journey through the Mahabharata, you see a mind moving through grief, doubt, distraction, focus, and finally, surrender. His experience on the battlefield of Kurukshetra offers a way to understand the different states your own mind can go through when faced with difficult situations and inner conflict.
